login.title: Sign in
login.error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Retry in %.0f s
error.standby: This Panel role is read-only. Use the control host for write operations.
overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Pending applies, upstream health, and recent rate-limit hits.
overview.top_empty: No rate-limit hits in the last 5 minutes
overview.top_empty_hint: No hits in the last 5 minutes, or metrics unavailable.
upstreams.title: Upstreams
upstreams.desc: Shared upstream library: alias, address, TCP/UDP, and enable.
upstreams.add_description: Creates an upstream only — no forwards.
upstreams.name: Name
upstreams.port_enable_hint: Fill a port to enable that protocol; leave empty to skip.
upstreams.need_ports: Enter at least one TCP or UDP port
upstreams.confirm_body: Deletes “%s” and its forwards. Irreversible until you restore from Changes.
upstreams.empty_hint: Add an upstream, or use Quick onboard for a batch.
upstreams.promote_hint: Enable production forwards for this upstream; creates them if missing.
upstreams.promote_confirm: Enable production forwards for %s? (Validation stays unchanged; missing forwards are created.)
upstreams.quick_description: Batch-write upstreams, optionally with first production entries (validation optional).
upstreams.quick_done_body: Upstreams written. Checked entries are created too.
upstreams.quick_need_rows: Add at least one valid upstream row
upstreams.quick_paste_hint: One per line: alias IP:port, e.g. server-01 185.244.208.205:4301
forwards.title: Forwards
forwards.desc: Entry type, protocol, listen, and toggles.
forwards.empty_hint: Add a forward with an upstream and entry type.
acl.title: Access lists
acl.add_description: Pick a list and enter a CIDR or IP.
acl.empty_hint: Add a CIDR or IP to this list.
config.title: Config
config.desc: Edit and save the full YAML config.
config.edit_warning: Save replaces the whole file and overwrites unsaved form edits.
config.saved_hint: Not applied on this gateway yet:
config.toast_conflict: File changed elsewhere; reloaded — edit again
apply.title: Apply
apply.desc: Make saved config or firewall live on this host, or publish a config version for fleet nodes to pull.
apply.hint_config: Make saved config live on this host
apply.hint_config_hot: Hot-apply config on this host: forwarding stays up; most sessions keep
apply.hint_config_hard: Restart forwarding on this host: all sessions drop
apply.hint_firewall: Reload firewall rules on this host
apply.hint_publish: Publish a config version; nodes pull and apply gateway config on their hosts
apply.publish_confirm_body: Publishes the current business config as a new fleet version; nodes pull and apply gateway config on their hosts.
apply.reload_confirm_body: Backs up and renders config, then restarts forwarding on this host.
apply.hot_confirm_body: Backs up and hot-applies config on this host without restarting forwarding.
apply.fw_confirm_body: Flushes and reloads firewall rules on this host.
apply.none_hint: No pending summaries or results yet.
ops.title: Ops
ops.desc: Local diagnostics, drain, smoke/canary, firewall check, rate limits, and profiles.
fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.desc: Gateway-node registry: join or retire nodes.
fleet.empty_hint: Use Generate join command (top right) on the target host to connect to control.
fleet.join_desc: Enter a node name and generate an install command to connect it to control.
fleet.join_command_hint: Run as root on the target host. Contains a one-time token — do not post publicly.
fleet.leave_confirm_body: Removes “%s” from the registry and revokes its agent credential.
fleet.leave_confirm_body_generic: Removes the gateway node from the registry and revokes its agent credential.
fleet.manual_nlb: Remaining manual step (optional cloud front door)
fleet.toast_copy_err: Copy failed; select the command manually
ops.drain_confirm_fail: This host will fail health probes and stop taking new connections.
ops.drain_confirm_ok: Restores health probes so this host takes new connections again.
ops.drain_hint: Stops new traffic; may wait tens of seconds. Existing connections usually remain.
ops.profile_confirm_body: Writes host defaults only; does not restart forwarding.
ops.profile_empty_hint: This host has no ops profiles, or they failed to load.
apply.hint_security_firewall: Reload host firewall rules (access ACL / rate limits)
apply.security_firewall_confirm_body: Flushes and reloads the host firewall ruleset.
apply.security_firewall_confirm_disconne: A bad ruleset can cut SSH. Keep this session and have console access ready.
security.title: Security policies
security.desc: Configure security domains; apply each domain separately after save.
security.add_protection_desc: Pick a built-in protection not yet in the draft. Click Save policies to write config. Source ACL (access) is edited separately on this page.
security.add_protection_full: All built-in protections are already added
security.add_protection_full_hint: At most one entry per type. Edit existing policies below, or remove an entry from config before adding it again.
security.add_protection_toast: Added to draft — save policies to write config
security.params_json_hint: JSON object; keys and values are stored as-is (no field i18n or format checks).
security.params_json_invalid: params must be a valid JSON object. Fix it before saving.
security.save_hint: Save writes resources.yaml; apply Kernel / Firewall / Gateway separately (node agent can auto-apply).
security.preview_apply_kernel: relaygate security apply-kernel --verify (or node agent after pull)
security.preview_apply_firewall: Security page «Apply security policies» or Apply page firewall step
security.scenario_desc: Switching a scenario loads the editor; nothing is saved until you click Save.
security.access_hint: Source deny/allow; scenario profiles skip access unless explicit
security.acl_lines_hint: One CIDR or IP per line
security.firewall_confirm_body: Renders from saved config and updates the host firewall ruleset.
security.firewall_confirm_disconnect: A bad ruleset can cut SSH. Keep this session and have console access ready.
changes.title: Changes
changes.desc: Browse change summaries by timestamp; roll back when needed.
changes.rollback_body: Restores that stamp's config and restarts forwarding on this host.
changes.no_summary: (no summary file; stamp can still be rolled back)
monitoring.disabled: Monitoring is off. Configure Grafana URL, enable the Grafana component, then restart Panel.
upstreams.add_entry_description: Create missing validation or production entry forwards for this upstream.
upstreams.toast_entry_none: Entry already exists for %s — nothing created
forwards.add_description: Pick an existing upstream plus entry type and protocols.
forwards.enable_production_missing: No production forwards yet — add one first
apply.migrate_title: Forwarding will restart on this host
apply.migrate_body: Hot apply is not enabled on this host yet. Apply gateway config will restart forwarding and drop existing sessions. After that, zero-downtime hot apply works.
fleet.standby_body: Publish/join/leave are disabled on this read-only role. Use the control component.
apply.hot_confirm_disconnect: Sessions on changed or removed listeners may drop.
apply.reload_confirm_disconnect: All sessions on this host drop; clients must reconnect.
apply.fw_confirm_disconnect: Mistakes can drop remote sessions — keep this session and have cloud console ready.
apply.publish_confirm_disconnect: Nodes may drop sessions if they change or remove listeners.
ops.drain_confirm_fail_disconnect: Existing sessions usually stay; on a single node this gateway accepts no new traffic.
ops.profile_confirm_disconnect: Applying config afterward may interrupt connections.
changes.rollback_disconnect: Existing sessions on this host will drop.
